items.title: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) Completes Taylor Morrison Deal As CORT Expands Globally
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway has completed its acquisition of Taylor Morrison, making it the fourth largest US homebuilder. These moves increase Berkshire Hathaway's presence in residential construction and global mobility and temporary living services.
